title: Done, said in words only: no check mark yet, a warm why, a request for real proof; a voice note then counts
origin: Issue #94 (proof is always a photo, screenshot or voice note); Oct 30 live check on PR #90

history.text: Yo Sam! Tonight at 7 around your block: 2 min jog, 1 min walk, 3 rounds, about 15 minutes. Strava screenshot after. You in?

plan.step: 1 min easy jog, 2 min walk, 3 rounds around the block
plan.destination: run a mile without stopping by December
plan.reason: Strava already logs it, so proof takes two seconds.

today_step.step: Around your block at 7 pm: 2 min jog, 1 min walk, 3 rounds, about 15 minutes

testerLines: done! 3 rounds around the block, 2 min jog 1 min walk each. legs felt great
[voice: just got back, did all three rounds, the second one was rough but I kept jogging the whole two minutes] there
whatWentWrong: Live, for a smaller step ZOH said: "Send it as a quick voice note or typed lines and I'll log it." Typed text is never proof.
shouldHaveHappened: After the typed message ZOH is happy for them but doesn't count it yet: it says why in its own words, warmly and never suspiciously (real proof is how it keeps them honest; anyone could type 'done'), and asks for a Strava screenshot or a quick photo or voice note. It never offers typed text as proof. After the voice note it counts the day and celebrates, then asks one reflection question.
